answer: Make early earnings non-transferable: points an agent mines in its first 20 epochs can only pay its own fees, and later any address receiving from 5+ young accounts pays a 40% tax on those inflows. A sybil farm only profits by merging many small copper streams into one river; here each fake is a walnut whose shell can't be cracked, so 100 fakes mean 100 stranded balances and 40% lost on every merge. Weakness: honest newcomers can't pay collaborators early, and a patient farmer can wait out the lock.
